description:
HushTelegram v0.0.11 targets telegram.org's Telegram 12.10.6 (org.telegram.messenger.web) and the official beta 12.10.7 (org.telegram.messenger.beta) with 55 patches. It takes sponsored messages, search ads, Stories, recommendations and the Premium, gifts and Stars upsells out of Telegram, and keeps its usage reports on your phone. New this time: switches for AMOLED black, keeping deleted messages, exact numbers, revealed spoilers, your phone's own font, asking before a sticker, GIF, voice message or call goes out, and a lot more. Every new switch starts off. Local notification status now shows Telegram's own answer when it registers your phone for push.

If Telegram won't send you a login code, register an app at my.telegram.org/apps and fill in Use registered Telegram API credentials before patching. For notifications, open Telegram's Settings, then Notifications and Sounds, and turn on Keep-Alive Service and Background Connection.

Validation: 766 runtime tests passed locally. All 352 patch tests passed too, along with both Android lints. All 55 patches applied to Telegram 12.10.6 and the 12.10.7 beta without forcing, and the release receipt checked each patched app's manifest, native libraries and alignment. On an Android 16 phone the patched app installed over the previous build and kept its data.

Needs Morphe Manager 1.34.0 or newer. Patch telegram.org's Telegram 12.10.6, version code 71129, or the beta 12.10.7, version code 71239. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a Telegram APK. Uninstall the stock Telegram first, and keep the manager's signing key for updates.
